column1: # KEGG BRITE pathway categories -> MSigDB C2:CP:KEGG gene-set names.
#   kegg_id  KEGG pathway number, for cross-checking against the KEGG page
#   label    plot title, keeps the KEGG section number
#   gs_name  gene-set name in the collection
# Rows follow the order KEGG lists them in, so this file can be diffed against
# the KEGG page directly. Species-specific pathways (yeast, fly, Caulobacter)
# are omitted; only the human entries are kept.
# Names follow the MSigDB convention: "DNA replication" -> KEGG_DNA_REPLICATION
# Entries listed here but absent from the results are reported as a WARNING in
# logs/GSEAKeggCategories/*.log and skipped; the plot still renders. A pathway
# can be missing either because the collection does not contain it or because
# fewer than min_size of its genes were detected -- see the README.
